name: mdtero-reader
description: Read, parse, and translate papers through your Mdtero account. Connects to the public Mdtero MCP service; this package does not include the parser.

interface.longDescription: Read, organize, parse, and translate papers in ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor through https://api.mdtero.com/mcp. Sign in with your Mdtero account. Save Elsevier keys only at https://api.mdtero.com/mcp/settings. Institutional full text requires publisher authorization; Relay can use your authorized campus device. Setup guide: https://mdtero.com/docs/install
defaultPrompt: Use Mdtero to find papers on this question, then open one in the reader.
Check my Mdtero setup, then parse this DOI once.
Check my Mdtero Elsevier key and campus Relay setup.
